Psilocybin Replaces Lost Synapses in Depressed Brains
items.snippet: Does healing the brain with psychedelics require a "trip"? A new study shows psilocybin drives synaptic plasticity through Layer 5 pyramidal neurons independently of hallucinogenic signaling, opening the door to non-hallucinogenic depression therapeutics.
